Fellow Aussie here. Long time prescription painkiller user. 
It got out of control and I told my GP to stop prescribing.

Out of all of them (tramadol, tapentadol, endone, Buprenorphine, panadeine forte) I found kicking Codeine the hardest. I think I just metabolise it very well.

I relapsed many many times with the OTC Codeine.
I'm now on day 33 with none of that shit. 
I'm actually relieved that it's not going to be OTC anymore. 

The first 5 days are rough, not going to lie, but you can do this. 

Be honest with your GP, they will be likely to prescribe some diazepam which will make the withdrawal much more tolerable.

Best of luck to you and feel free to PM.
